decisionBox.changed: Neither midday level fired (low 72,870 vs 72,000 reduce; high 74,061 vs 74,200 add). The bounce stalled under the 1H EMA20 with longs still crowded, so net exposure is cut overnight with a small 1x futures hedge rather than another spot sale. Bias softens from bearish to range with a bearish tilt.

overnightRisk: Spot stop at 71,800 recommended. Longs remain crowded (OKX 1H account L/S 3.04) with estimated long-liquidation brackets at 72.9k and 72.2k sitting just under the 72,727 day low: a break there in thin Asian hours can cascade toward 71.4k-70.7k. Spot ETFs printed three straight outflow days (Nov 5-9) and the Nov 10 row is not yet posted; another outflow print before the Asia/Europe open would weigh. US10Y at 5.00% and DXY 102.2 keep macro tight, and the US bond market is closed for Veterans Day (Nov 11), so liquidity is thinner. Upside risk: a reclaim of 74.8k squeezes the remaining shorts toward 75.2k.
